newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank of Greece to drain 250bln drs via depo tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Greece to drain 250bln drs via depo tender.

text.p: Greece's central bank offered to drain up to 250 billion drachmas of 14-day depos through a competitive interest rate tender on Wednesday, it said in a statement.
Payment date is March 5 and maturity value date March 19, it said.
"Allocation will be made in ascending order until the total amount is subscribed. In case of oversubscription, excess bids at the cut-off rate will be scaled down proportionately," it said.
The Bank of Greece reserves the right not to accept bids deviating significantly from market conditions, it added.
Bids should be submitted by fax between 1100 a.m. (0900 GMT) and 1200 noon (1000 GMT).
